siguiente.titulo: PGA Tour Golf • The RSM Classic, Second Round
siguiente.descripcion: The RSM Classic, Second Round | Round two of The RSM Classic continues at Sea Island Golf Club as players vie to make the cut. Golfers navigate the Tom Fazio-redesigned Seaside Course, a 7,157-yard, par-70 layout built in 1929 on St. Simons Island featuring bermudagrass greens.
